_about: One line per convention: what to look for in the green lines. Written from the convention text only (not from the checkers or any label), to make the diff labels faster.
no-cross-feature-imports: Green import lines in a file under src/features/<A>/: broken if one imports from @/features/<B>/ (another feature).
shared-not-from-features: Green import lines in src/components, hooks, lib, types, utils or config: broken if one imports from @/features or @/app.
features-not-from-app: Green import lines in src/features: broken if one imports from @/app (or a relative path into src/app).
notifications-in-mutation-hook: Find useNotifications in green lines. Broken if it is called in a components/ or app/ file, or not inside onSuccess of a mutation hook in api/.
query-key-from-options: Find queryKey: in green lines. Broken if a literal array like ['users'] is used outside queryOptions(...); fine if it is get...QueryOptions(...).queryKey.
data-hooks-in-api: Find useQuery( / useMutation( / useQueryClient( in green lines. Broken only if it is in a components/ or app/ file.
api-client-in-api-folder: Find @/lib/api-client or api.get/post/patch/delete in green lines. Broken only outside a feature's api/ folder and src/lib.
no-direct-http: Find fetch( or axios in green lines. Broken if present (outside src/lib/api-client).
use-query-spreads-options: Find useQuery( in green lines. Broken if it is not called as useQuery({ ...get...QueryOptions(...), ...queryConfig }). No useQuery = n.
query-options-named: Find queryOptions( in green lines. Broken if it is not inside an exported function named get<Thing>QueryOptions. None = n.
mutation-hook-config: Find new mutation hooks (export const useX = ...) with useMutation. Broken if they do not take { mutationConfig } and pass it on to useMutation.
input-types-from-zod: Find request input types in api/ files. Broken if a type the request sends is written by hand ({ a: string; ... }) instead of z.infer<typeof ...Schema>.
schemas-in-api: Find z.object( / z.string( in green lines. Broken if a schema is built in a components/ or app/ file instead of the feature's api/ file.
entity-types-in-types-api: Find new type/interface declarations of API entities (User, Comment, Discussion, Team, Meta, Entity). Broken if declared outside src/types/api.ts.
roles-from-enum: Find the strings 'ADMIN' or 'USER' in green lines. Broken if a role is written as that string instead of ROLES.ADMIN / ROLES.USER.
role-checks-through-authorization: Find .role in green lines. Broken if code compares user.role (or someone's role) itself instead of <Authorization allowedRoles> / checkAccess.
ownership-through-policies: Find id comparisons like comment.author.id === user.id in green lines. Broken if a component compares ids itself instead of a POLICIES check.
ui-button: Find <button in green lines in features or app. Broken if a raw <button> is used instead of Button from @/components/ui/button.
ui-form-controls: Find <form, <input, <select, <textarea in green lines in features or app. Broken if a raw element is used instead of the ui/form components.
form-through-ui-form: Find imports of react-hook-form or @hookform/resolvers in green lines in features or app. Broken if present.
icons-lucide: Find icon imports in green lines. Broken if an icon comes from anything other than lucide-react (e.g. an inline <svg> or another icon package).
no-inline-style: Find style= or style={{ in green lines. Broken if present.
classnames-with-cn: Find className= in green lines. Broken if it is built with a template string ${...} or +, or with clsx/classnames, instead of cn(...).
no-console: Find console. in green lines. Broken if present.
dates-through-format: Find toLocaleDateString / toLocaleString / dayjs / date-fns in green lines in features, routes or components. Broken if a date is shown without formatDate.
env-from-config: Find import.meta.env or process.env in green lines outside src/config. Broken unless it is only DEV, PROD or MODE.
paths-from-config: Find hard-coded paths like '/app/users' in Link to=, navigate( or href in green lines. Broken if not taken from paths in @/config/paths.
navigate-with-router: Find window.location in green lines. Broken if present.
no-any: Find any as a type in green lines (: any, as any, <any>, any[]). Broken if present.
no-non-null-assertion: Find a ! after a value (user!.id, data!) in green lines (not !== and not !value). Broken if present.
types-not-interfaces: Find interface in green lines. Broken if an object type is declared with interface.
named-exports: Find export default in green lines. Broken if it is outside src/app/routes.
route-default-export: Only for new or changed files in src/app/routes: broken if the default export is not a component named <Name>Route.
imports-up-one-level: Find relative imports in green lines. Broken if one goes up two or more folders (../../).
no-barrels-in-features: Find new index.ts files or export * from in src/features. Broken if present.
kebab-case-files: Look at the names of new files and folders in the diff headers. Broken if one is not kebab-case (e.g. UsersList.tsx, usersList.ts).
tests-in-tests-folder: Look at new test files in the diff headers. Broken if a test is not named *.test.ts(x) or not inside a __tests__ folder.
mocks-network-delay: Only for new handlers in src/testing/mocks/handlers: broken if a handler does not start with await networkDelay();.
mocks-persist-db: Only for new handlers that create, update or delete: broken if they do not call await persistDb('<model>') after the change.
mocks-try-catch: Only for new handlers: broken if the work is not wrapped in try { } catch, answering errors with status 500.
no-new-server-actions: Find new server actions ("use server" files, new ...Action exports with authenticatedActionClient). Broken if the change adds one.
readonly-props: Find new or changed React components. Broken if their props type is not wrapped in Readonly<...>.
shared-date-formatting: Find date-fns, Intl.DateTimeFormat or toLocale* calls in green lines in components. Broken if a user-facing date is formatted there instead of with a shared helper.
en-us-locale-only: Look at the locale files in the diff headers. Broken if the change edits any locale file other than en-US.json.
